clues.title: Plate: Red strip license plate
text: If you feel like you're in the UK or Ireland but notice a red strip on the license plates, you're in the Isle of Man.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Google car: Gen 2
text: Coverage on the Isle of Man is limited to Generation 2.
This camera can be recognized by the lower camera quality and circular blur above and below.
Colours will also seem slightly off.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Plate: Red Strip Yellow Plates
text: Similar to the United Kingdom, the Isle of Man uses white front licence plates with yellow rears, but with a red strip on the left.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)

clues.title: Landscape: Landscape
text: The general landscape on the Isle of Man consists of hilly farmland, and narrow roads passing through them.

credit.licence: Learnable Meta; notes partly from Plonk It (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0)
